title: Make check:fast supply or ask for GH_TOKEN
goal: An agent following AGENTS.md runs check:fast with a GitHub token and gets a clear message without one
acceptance: check:fast passes when run as AGENTS.md says, with gh logged in
Without a token the documented command names what is missing, not a bare 403
Changes stay in project-owned lines or scripts; copied harness tools are not edited
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one script or two project lines, then a run with and without a token. Not a measurement.
